declarations.description:
Drag-and-drop file uploader with multiple selection, validation and an attachment-based upload queue. Set an async
`uploadHandler(file, { signal, onProgress })` property to connect transport; the component owns progress, success,
error, retry, cancel and removal UI while leaving network policy to the application.
declarations.name: Upload

slots.description: Replaces the upload-cloud icon in the drop zone.
slots.name: drop-icon

slots.description: Replaces the accepted-type and size hint.
slots.name: hint

members.name: multiple
members.description: Accept several files in one browse or drop operation.

members.name: variant
members.description: Dropzone provides drag-and-drop; compact renders only an upload button.

members.name: accept
members.description: Comma-separated MIME types or file extensions, using the native file-input syntax.

members.name: maxFiles
members.description: Maximum number of queued files. Zero means unlimited.

members.name: maxSize
members.description: Maximum size of each file in bytes. Zero means unlimited.

members.name: autoUpload
members.description: Run `uploadHandler` immediately after files are accepted.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables browsing, dropping and attachment actions.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires at least one selected file for native form validation.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. Each queued file is appended with this name.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the drop zone.

members.name: uploadHandler
members.description: Application-provided transport. Report percentages through `onProgress`; respect `signal` to support cancel.

members.name: items
members.description: Current queue, including ready, uploading, complete and failed items.

members.name: value
members.description: Selected files. Assign a new array to replace the queue.

members.name: addFiles
members.description: Validates and adds files supplied by the browser, drag-and-drop or application code.

members.name: upload
members.description: Upload every ready/error item, or one item by id.

members.name: retry
members.description: Retry a failed or ready item.

members.name: removeFile
members.description: Cancels an active upload and removes its attachment.

members.name: clear
members.description: Cancels and removes every queued file.

type.text: UploadEventMap[K] extends CustomEvent<infer D> ? D : never

events.name: input
events.description: Fired whenever the file value changes, for form and framework bindings.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired whenever files are added or removed, for form and framework bindings.
Fired after valid files enter the queue through browse, drop or `addFiles()`.
events.name: files-selected

events.description: Fired when type, size, count or single-file rules reject files.
events.name: file-reject

events.description: Fired when an item begins uploading.
events.name: upload-start

events.description: Fired when the upload handler reports progress.
events.name: upload-progress

events.description: Fired after an upload handler resolves; `item.result` contains its result.
events.name: upload-success

events.description: Fired after an upload handler rejects; `item.error` contains the error.
events.name: upload-error

events.description: Fired after an item is removed or an active upload is cancelled.
events.name: upload-remove
